description: This Kotlin source file defines an adapter class for a product media gallery in an Android application, specifically used in the product details section to display placeholder images for media items without loading remote images.

classes.name: ProductMediaAdapter
classes.description: An internal RecyclerView adapter managing product media placeholders, with a callback to notify when the first item is visible.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for the adapter, handling binding of placeholder views and setting accessibility descriptions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Sets the list of media URLs and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders, including setting accessibility content descriptions and notifying when the first item is visible.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of media items.

methods.name: VH.bind
methods.description: Assigns accessibility descriptions to placeholder views indicating image position.
